stage: common checkpoints plus frozen diagnostics ONLY
question: After reducing intermediate cropping and repeated resampling, how much conditional-response mismatch remains? Feedback compensation is deferred, not identified by this frozen experiment.
novelty_limits: Depth>2 decline and pairwise ROR appear in Ctrl-A
Lazy Resampling already studies reducing intermediate crop/resampling; affine fusion alone is not a novelty claim
Ctrl-A does not promise accuracy products or zero interaction error

dataset.name: official CIFAR-10 training only
dataset.test: never extracted, loaded, evaluated or selected upon
dataset.historical_use: No traceable local CIFAR-10 assets identified; new split is not independent-confirmation evidence

training.model: pinned model_lib.airbench_net, including frozen unwhitened first convolution and channels_last
training.preprocessing: official modified: original+horizontal-mirror concatenation, edge-pad4 RandomCrop32, official PIL ControlAugment, tensor, fit-only normalize
training.sampling: uniform ordered without replacement; independent strength and sign
training.epoch10: continuation checkpoint at boundary of horizon20; complete controller update for epoch11 but no epoch11 training
training.kappa: phase mean online training augmented CE / phase mean end-of-epoch eval clean-controller CE
training.health_stop: after epoch5: accuracy<0.20 and clean CE >= initial CE; after epoch10: accuracy<0.35 or clean CE >0.90*initial CE => implementation/learning indeterminate, no mechanistic negative claim

controller_ror.sign: official alternating +,- by fixed randomized controller order, recorded separately from training random sign

challenge.prefix: 4 distinct ordered uniform samples from other 14
challenge.N2: last2 of same N5 ordered sequence; uniform marginal reference only
challenge.signed_ops: balanced +/- exactly across original images separately for each terminal-op/position, randomly permuted
challenge.strengths: shared uniform quantiles transformed by frozen ASD inverse CDF; all N5 ops multiplied by one coefficient
challenge.base: one fixed flip and edge-pad4 crop per original, shared across all terminal ops and renderers

renderers.S: official sequential PIL on original32 canvas
renderers.E: only consecutive affine blocks: original-coordinate matrices, extended canvas retaining all intermediate supports plus interpolation halo, sequential bilinear resampling, crop to32 at block end
renderers.F: same blocks and extent as E, compose original-coordinate inverse matrices and resample once, same final crop
renderers.single_affine: all renderers use exact official operation for blocks of length1

matching.target: N2 S frozen mean augmented CE at checkpoint ASD coefficient1
matching.selection: evaluate grid per renderer; choose adjacent target-crossing bracket with smallest endpoint residual (tie lower bracket), 4 bisections; no bracket => retain closest grid, mark feasibility; choose evaluated coefficient with smallest absolute relative CE residual, tie lower coefficient
matching.audit_acceptance: point estimate and 95% paired image bootstrap CI for relative CE difference must lie wholly inside [-0.05,+0.05]
matching.failure: report failed match and do not exclude total difficulty
matching.same_parameter_matched: N5 S-selected coefficient applied identically to S/E/F; these share geometry and photometric parameters
matching.renderer_rematched: E/F own CE-matched coefficients; this is not net-equal geometry and is separate

metrics.denominator_invalid: denominator accuracy <0.10 OR <100 correct original images in corresponding op stratum; no imputation
metrics.aggregation: uniform official terminal-op probability 1/15, plus all15 operation strata; no worst-combination selection
metrics.CI: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of original image IDs, retain all15 views; percentile95%; fixed bootstrap seed20261032; report seeds separately; not training-seed uncertainty

resource_gate.requirements: each seed Delta_err >= +0.02 and each paired 95% CI lower bound >0
resource_gate.role: resource screen only, not publication standard
resource_gate.online_branch_authorization: none in this task; even passing requires parent review

budgets.starts: first full model synthetic MPS benchmark, includes subsequent elapsed time
budgets.partial: save completed checkpoint/logs and mark indeterminate on budget limit

limitations: Shortened mechanism experiment, not final paper accuracy reproduction
Two seeds do not establish training-seed uncertainty
PIL uint8 quantization preserved; Hue(0) HSV conversion and Solarize(0) threshold255 are not exact byte identity in pinned implementation
Feedback compensation not tested in frozen phase
